What moves the price

  • Size and layout. More square feet and more bathrooms cost more.
  • Finish level. Standard selections are included. Upgrades add cost.
  • Site conditions. Slope, access, and distance to utilities.
  • Attachment. A breezeway or addition is different work than a detached home.
  • City fees. Permit and utility fees vary by city.

Finished or shell

A shell home includes the finished exterior with rough plumbing, electrical and framing, at about 60% of the cost of a finished unit. Learn about shells.
